summary: Ørsted reports conducting a double materiality assessment (DMA) in accordance with ESRS 1 and EFRAG guidance, identifying 40 material impacts, risks, and opportunities (IROs). Climate change (E1), biodiversity and ecosystems (E4), resource use and circular economy (E5), and affected communities (S3) are highlighted as the company's most material sustainability matters, aligning with its strategy to be a leading green energy major.
